Are you passionate about life sciences and eager to make a global impact in an international environment? At Oroboros Instruments in Innsbruck, you will join an innovative team driving the success of the world-leading Oroboros Bioenergetics Platform for measuring cell respiration.

To expand our team, we are looking to fill the following position as soon as possible: 1 Full-Stack Developer & Process Expert (m/f/d) (32 - 38.5 hours/week)

Your responsibilities

Customer Relationship Management (CRM) system:

 * Improve and maintain our Excel-based CRM system and implement new features, configuration and customization options, and support its integration with internal and external systems

 * Automate and optimize CRM-related manual processes through the development of tools to improve data quality and reduce error potential

 * Analyze internal sales processes to identify opportunities for software and/or workflow improvements and gather feedback from team members for quality and usability

Software development:

 * Experience with one or more of the following is a plus: C#, C++, Java, Qt (QML), R, Node.js, PHP, Go, .NET, as well as front-end technologies HTML, CSS or JavaScript

 * Interest in data analysis and experience with data management

 * Willingness to work in an interdisciplinary team with sales experts, mitochondrial physiologists, and other software developers

 * Proactive working style, flexibility, the ability to work in a team and strong communication skills are expected

 * Full working proficiency in English is required, German is a plus

Our offer

 * A diverse area of responsibility with impact and room for professional development

 * An international and collaborative team that welcomes different perspectives

 * Flexible working hours and the option to work remotely for up to two days/week

 * Support on your public transportation ticket and an initial German course for non-native speakers
